tools.name: diamond_catalog
tools.description: Free. Lists Diamond's paid Bitcoin intelligence tools with prices in sats and USD, payment methods (x402 USDC on Base, Lightning) and terms.

tools.name: bitcoin_sanctions_screen
tools.description: Free. Is this Bitcoin address on the OFAC SDN sanctions list or a known ransomware payment address? Exact list matches only. For ownership clusters, sweeper bots and laundering patterns use bitcoin_address_risk.

tools.name: bitcoin_address_risk
tools.description: Screens one Bitcoin address: OFAC sanctions, ransomware payment lists, ownership clusters, sweeper bots and laundering-pattern cases seen by this node. Price: 300 sats or US$0.25 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: bitcoin_market_pulse
tools.description: Live: fee rates (1 block to 1 day), mempool, last 24 h whale transactions and AML cases from this node, implied BTC/USD. Price: 20 sats or US$0.02 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: whale_geopolitics_report
tools.description: One day's report: whale flows vs world news, lagged correlations, laundering patterns, headlines and the analyst brief (JSON). Price: 1000 sats or US$0.8 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: watch_bitcoin_address
tools.description: Alerts for 30 days on every confirmed transaction paying to or spending from the address: private feed (web, JSON, RSS) and phone push. Returns the feed links. Price: 1000 sats or US$1 (USDC) per call.
